problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate a fleet of delivery vehicles from distribution centers to retail outlets in order to minimize total fuel expenditure.

The available number of vehicles at each distribution center (group X) is as follows:  
*Center X1 has 78 vehicles ready.  
*Center X2 has 56 vehicles ready.  
*Center X3 has 120 vehicles ready.

The required number of vehicles at each retail outlet (group Y) is detailed below:  
*Outlet Y1 requires 25 vehicles.  
*Outlet Y2 requires 18 vehicles.  
*Outlet Y3 requires 131 vehicles.

The fuel cost per vehicle dispatched from each distribution center to each retail outlet is provided in the following table:

| From / To | Y1 | Y2 | Y3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | 18 | 3 | 19 |
| X2 | 14 | 2 | 1 |
| X3 | 3 | 7 | 8 |

Determine the optimal vehicle dispatch plan to minimize the overall fuel cost.
